scenes.text:
...I don't talk to guests.

Come back when you've proven you know your way around a hash function.

You cracked it. Good. Not many do.

I need a relay chip delivered to the ETH2 gateway. The chip is yours.

Don't ask what it does. Just place it in the receiver frame.

And don't make noise getting there.
